title: Prevent overlapping entries for the same resource
gherkin:
Feature: Overlap Prevention
  Scenario: Prevent overlapping entries for the same resource
    Given a resource is booked from 10:00 to 11:00
    When a user attempts to book the same resource from 10:30 to 11:30
    Then the booking should be rejected with an error message "Booking overlaps with an existing entry"
rationale: This test ensures that the system correctly identifies and prevents overlapping bookings for the same resource.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the overlap prevention rule requirement, ensuring that overlapping entries are not allowed in the system.
